app_links.note: Web-based platform; no official mobile app — everything runs in the browser dashboard.

biggest_catch: New signups join a waitlist and study flow depends entirely on researcher demand matching your demographics, so earnings are irregular, not a steady stream.
catches: New signups currently join a waitlist — you are invited only when tasks are available.
Study flow depends on researcher demand matching your demographics; earnings are not steady.
Researchers can reject submissions, which means no pay for that study.
Some studies may effectively underpay if they take longer than the researcher's estimate (Prolific polices this via median-time recalculation).

c1.evidence: Prolific is a real company, co-founded at Oxford University in 2014, operating a live research-participant platform for 10+ years.

c2.evidence: Official participant help center states a concrete minimum reward rate: researchers must pay at least £6/$8 per hour.

c3.evidence: Participant signup is free; no fee, deposit, or purchase is required anywhere in the participant flow.

c4.evidence: Terms state concrete payout: minimum £6/$8 per hour, cashout at $6/£6 balance, paid in cash via PayPal (never gift cards or points).

eligibility: Over 18, verified account, resident in a supported (mostly OECD) country; waitlist if your country is not supported.
notes: Strong verify: hard minimum pay rate is enforced by the platform (not a suggestion). Route claim 'must pay ≥$8/hr' matches official terms exactly. s1.note: Official help: must be over 18 with a verified account; open to most OECD countries (US, UK, Canada, Germany, Japan, etc.); waitlist elsewhere.

s2.note: Catches documented: studies are opt-in and tailored by eligibility filters; submissions can be rejected by researchers; new signups currently join a waitlist.

s3.note: Paid after researcher approves the submission; cashout available once balance reaches $6/£6; after the first 4 cashouts, PayPal transfers are instant.

s4.note: Core payout uses a hard rule ('must pay at least £6/$8 per hour — this is our absolute minimum reward rate'). 'Recommend £9/$12+' is advisory only, not the core promise.

s5.note: Official participant entry page captured: https://www.prolific.com/participants (signup/waitlist flows from there).

s6.note: Steps are concrete and user-doable: waitlist signup, invite, ID verification (~15 min), practice task, dashboard studies.

s7.note: prolific.com/participants and participant-help.prolific.com pages loaded live during this check.

steps: Go to https://www.prolific.com/participants and click Sign up to join the waitlist (about 3 minutes: email, password, basic info).
Watch for the invite email and accept it when tasks become available for your profile.
Verify your identity with a photo ID (about 15 minutes) and complete the short practice task.
Fill out the 'About you' profile questions — these decide which studies you are offered.
Open your Studies dashboard, pick a study, and check its stated reward and estimated time before starting.
Complete the study in one sitting, following the instructions, then submit your responses.
Once the researcher approves and your balance reaches $6/£6, cash out from your Prolific account to PayPal.
timing: Paid after the researcher approves your submission; cash out from your Prolific account once you reach $6/£6; PayPal transfers are instant after your first 4 cashouts.
